cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

mechanism: A treats poster decisions as permissions while using each choice and concession as an unannounced measure of personal loyalty.
confusable: Ordinary editorial control judges image quality; A must read preference and placement as evidence of allegiance while denying that motive.
comparison: The poster scene tests professional-looking fairness against personal favors; the moving scene tests availability against a competing friendship.
seedUse: D11-a supplies competing photographs and equal treatment; S01 turns A judgments into conditional permissions rather than pleas.
